entities.summary: Carina Marguerite Benninga is a former Dutch field hockey player, who played 158 international matches for the Netherlands hockey team, in which she scored 25 goals. She was part of the gold medal winning team at the 1984 Summer Olympics and also won a bronze medal at the 1988 Seoul Olympics. Other highlights of her career include gold medals at the EuroHockey Nations Championship and Champions Trophy in 1987, as well as a gold at the 1983 Women's Hockey World Cup and the 1990 Women's Hockey World Cup. Next to her sports career, Carina Benninga studied law; in 1987 she got her Masters’ degree.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a gold medal-winning field hockey player at the 1984 Summer Olympics and multiple World Cups, Carina Benninga's achievements represent a significant moment in Dutch sports history. Her success paved the way for future generations of female athletes.
